description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Galigamuwa, Rambukkana, Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabhas has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that members of various Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) have vacated their offices due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content specifically relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government bodies, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about elected officials.
